props.name: anchor
props.description:
An element to position the popup against.
By default, root context menus are positioned at the pointer, and submenus are positioned
against their trigger.

props.name: side
props.description:
Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
May automatically change to avoid collisions.

Submenus default to `'inline-end'`.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description:
Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

Defaults to `-5` for root context menus when `side` is not specified and `align` is not
`'center'`. Otherwise, it defaults to `0`.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description:
Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

Defaults to `2` for root context menus when `side` is not specified and `align` is not
`'center'`. Otherwise, it defaults to `0`.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description:
Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

Root context menus always use `0`. Submenus default to `5`.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: sticky
props.description:
Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after
the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description:
Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup.

`side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`):
- `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side
  (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`).
- `'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within
  the clipping boundary so it stays visible.
- `'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow.

`align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`):
- `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows.
- `'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the
  alignment axis to fit.
- `'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow.

`fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the
preferred axis cannot fit:
- `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first
  (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR).
- `'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first
  (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR).
- `'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis.

When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`.
If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void) | undefined
props.description:
Determines the element to focus when the menu is closed.

- `false`: Do not move focus.
- `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element).
- `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element.
- `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
  Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the menu is opened or closed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The visual orientation of the menu.
Controls whether roving focus uses up/down or left/right arrow keys.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is currently open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the menu is initially open.

To render a controlled menu, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description:
Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them.
Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the menu after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
  Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the menu completes closing on its own.
  Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.
- `close`: Closes the menu imperatively when called.

props.name: onItemHighlighted
props.type: ((highlightedItem: HTMLElement | undefined, eventDetails: MenuRoot.HighlightEventDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted.
Receives the highlighted item element (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and details
containing the reason for the change, the event, and the item's text label.
The `reason` can be:
- `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation.
- `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering. The event may be a `MouseEvent`
  rather than a `PointerEvent`.
- `'none'`: the highlight changed for another reason, such as automatic highlighting while
  filtering, the item list changing, or the popup opening or closing.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the menu is opened or closed.
